description: Free. Searches the official company register of the given country for the company name and returns the matching entities (idx, registry reference, name, address), an order id, and what a report covers. Nothing is charged. Supported country codes: GB, FR, NO, FI, CZ, EE, SK, LV, IL, CA, CY, US (CA: federal corporations only; US: SEC reporting companies only).
